task: Phase 6 -- Hirist discovery/feasibility inspection ONLY, no implementation

live_requests_made.method: plain HTTP GET via curl, no browser

executive_summary: The single live test succeeded technically with no block, challenge, login wall, or CAPTCHA encountered. Hirist served a real, populated public jobs-search results page containing 20 job listings (of a claimed 3441 total), embedding schema.org JSON-LD structured job data and revealing its real pagination URL pattern via a rel=next link tag. robots.txt is markedly more permissive than LinkedIn's, with no disallow rule on search/job paths. This does not by itself constitute confirmed authorization for automated extraction, which remains unknown.
